segments.name: Automobile Contracts
segments.description: Purchases and services retail automobile contracts from dealers for sub-prime customers with limited credit histories or past credit problems.
segments.evidence: Our business is to purchase and service retail automobile contracts originated primarily by franchised automobile dealers and, to a lesser extent, by select independent dealers in the United States in the sale of new and used automobiles, light trucks and passenger vans.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay interest on automobile contracts purchased from dealers; the company earns interest income from financed contracts and acquisition fees from dealers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenue primarily consists of interest income and is derived from the interest recorded on contracts the Company has purchased.
